description: boto3 client created inside handler function body
impact: 50-300ms latency added per warm invocation due to new SDK session
fix_summary: Move to module level or use lazy-init pattern

description: boto3 client or resource is created without botocore Config
impact: reduced connection reuse and weaker retry/timeout behavior on warm invocations
fix_summary: Add a shared Config block and pass config=_BOTO_CONFIG

description: botocore Config is not imported even though boto3 is used
impact: prevents standard Lambda client tuning from being applied consistently

description: logger level is hardcoded instead of controlled by environment
impact: requires redeploy to change verbosity and can increase logging overhead

description: handler does not emit a structured invocation log at startup
impact: harder CloudWatch correlation and slower troubleshooting per invocation
fix_summary: Add logger.info(json.dumps({...})) near the top of lambda_handler

description: paginator is used without a surrounding TTL cache check
impact: 100-500ms of repeated list API latency may be paid on warm invocations
fix_summary: Wrap paginator results in a module-level TTL cache

description: AWS API call appears inside a loop body
impact: creates N+1 latency and cost patterns proportional to item count
fix_summary: Batch requests where possible or cache per-item lookups

description: boto3 client or resource hardcodes a region string
impact: reduces portability and can break when the function is deployed outside that region
fix_summary: Omit region_name or source it from AWS_REGION

description: broad exception handler appears before any boto3-specific error handling
impact: obscures AWS-specific failures and makes troubleshooting less precise
fix_summary: Catch ClientError and BotoCoreError before a final broad except
